data_manifest.label_definition: full expected payload after DIRECT/ASK/TOOL colon; calculator label includes calculator name and exact ordered arguments, joint includes color and pitch
data_manifest.majority_baseline_scope: per-task constant payload baseline, before runtime final-answer generation; constant-answer concept/missing/safety tasks can reach 100% without task understanding

split_policy.audio: seeded family split with minimal deterministic swaps; low/high each 8 train, 1 validation, 1 test families; all three frequency variants stay together
split_policy.numbers: canonical unordered operand families; both question orientations and all task descendants stay together; reserve (1,2) for test before training

data_manifest.limitations: synthetic RGB shapes/tones and narrow Chinese templates, not natural multimodal understanding

ce.initialization: identical random Dense state, not inherited MoE weights

kd.objective: 0.5 answer-only CE + 0.5 KL(teacher||student), T=2, includes T²
kd.initialization: identical random Dense state, not inherited MoE weights

cpu.scope: Untrained Dense model; checks format/storage, not task competence or GPU performance

finite_card_boundary.scope: No PPO updates; verifies four existing answer strings are selected rather than token generation
